limitations: Block arrays, SVD spectra, block-fitted scales, and block-specific ranks are oracle diagnostics; no compressor entry access changed.

The black-box scale wrapper and its independent calibration probes are implementable, but this codebase exposes only one global k,p; per-level policies need a small scheduling API extension and block-specific ranks require a redesign.
Whole-block reconstruction is only a screen proxy for the frozen global error; it cannot establish the full operator gate.

black_box_scaling.rule: Two independent forward columns estimate output component RMS; two independent transpose columns after output scaling estimate input RMS. These four calibration columns are counted in every candidate budget.

promotion.rule: A full BP7 run is authorized only if the predeclared candidate's worst output-or-input component reconstruction error is at most 0.08, its worst whole-block reconstruction error does not exceed the incumbent representative 0.029231984038525255 proxy, and its complete fixed-pattern budget including scaling calibration is strictly below 11040.

strata.rule: At every admissible level, sort all pairs by scalar area then dyadic cells and select these four area quantiles. This is deterministic, bounded, and deliberately not the prior largest/first rule.

promotion.decision: no full run was launched by this bounded screen

predeclared_gate.rule: A full BP7 run is authorized only if the predeclared candidate's worst output-or-input component reconstruction error is at most 0.08, its worst whole-block reconstruction error does not exceed the incumbent representative 0.029231984038525255 proxy, and its complete fixed-pattern budget including scaling calibration is strictly below 11040.
